title: Role-play lab: six goal conversations
objectives: Answer six goal conversations using amounts, dates and priorities.
Use the module's scenario answers (Q21–Q25) as trainer-marked practice.
body_md:
In pairs. One person plays the client, the other explains — in plain words, with a rupee example.

| Client says | Explain |
| --- | --- |
| “Just tell me the best fund.” | Redirect the conversation to goals, amounts and dates: the goal decides the mix and the fund. |
| A couple wants to fund their son's MBA in 12 years and retire in 20. | Prioritise, quantify both with inflation, and discuss the education-vs-retirement trade-off. |
| “I need ₹10 lakh for a car in 2 years; put it in small caps for better returns.” | Explain why short-term goals belong in debt. |
| A client's retirement goal is 30% behind plan. | Walk through the four levers without promising higher returns. |
| A goal is 3 years away and still 80% in equity. | Explain the glide path and plan the shift, including tax. |
| “Markets fell 15%. Should I stop the education SIP?” | Use the goal's time frame to keep the client on track. |

> **Investor takeaway:** Quiz scenarios Q21–Q25 (trainer-marked): a scenario answer earns its mark if it covers at least three model points and makes no promise of returns.
example: Role-play the car question: ₹10 lakh in 2 years in small caps risks a fall just before the purchase — short-term money belongs in debt.
say: Start with the goal, not the fund.
Never chase returns to catch up.
never: Recommend funds before goals are clear.
Promise a goal will be met.

check.q: A client says, “Just tell me the best fund.” How do you respond?
o: Redirect to goals: what for, how much, when, priority; explain that the goal decides the mix and the fund
Ask for their risk profile only
check.why: Redirects to goals: what for, how much, when, priority; explains that the goal decides the mix and the fund.

check.q: A couple wants to fund their son’s MBA in 12 years and retire in 20. How do you plan?
o: Quantify both with inflation; prioritise; discuss the education-loan vs retirement trade-off; separate mixes and SIPs
Fund the MBA first and ignore retirement
Use the same mix for both
check.why: Quantifies both with inflation; prioritises; discusses education loan vs retirement; separate mixes and SIPs.

check.q: A client wants ₹10 lakh for a car in 2 years in small-cap funds “for better returns”. What do you say?
o: Explain short-horizon risk; recommend debt (short duration / target maturity); no equity for near goals
Say 2 years is long enough for equity
check.why: Explains short-horizon risk; recommends debt (short duration / target maturity); no equity for near goals.
